Macguire Cheswick & Tuttle Investment Counsel Decreased Its Apple (AAPL) Position as Shares Declined; Artemis Investment Management Llp Has Boosted Its Fifth Third Bancorp (FITB) Stake by $2.06 Million as Stock Rose
April 27, 2018 - By Marie Mckinney
Macguire Cheswick & Tuttle Investment Counsel Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL) by 2.03% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Macguire Cheswick & Tuttle Investment Counsel Llc sold 3,054 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 147,138 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $24.90 million, down from 150,192 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Macguire Cheswick & Tuttle Investment Counsel Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $821.13 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.46% or $2.39 during the last trading session, reaching $161.83. About 15.32 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Artemis Investment Management Llp increased its stake in Fifth Third Bancorp (FITB) by 8.4% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC.
